description: What the shell needs in order to get unsaved orders onto disk before the window closes, to hand the releases page to a browser, and to save a map export where the player asks. There was no capability file at all until now, because commands this application defines itself are not gated by the ACL; onCloseRequested and destroy are core-plugin calls and are refused without one. core:default is Tauri's own baseline and carries the event listening; destroy is not in it, being the one call that ends the window, so it is named here. opener:allow-open-url is scoped to this repository rather than granted outright: the update check needs exactly one address, and a webview that can ask the operating system to open anything is a larger thing to own than that. The save dialog and the write beside it are what let the desktop tell the player where an export went; the write permission is the plugin's baseline, which allows only paths the player themselves chose in that dialog, and no read permission is granted at all. http:default is scoped the same way opener:allow-open-url is, to the one host a faction's orders are posted to: sending orders is the only request this shell makes, and a webview that can post anywhere is a larger thing to own than that. atlantis-newage.com is the second host, and for the same shape of reason: a New Age world serves its report, its turn history and its orders endpoint over a REST API the desktop build talks to directly, and it allowlists CORS origins so the web build cannot.
